name: c588mhh
title: Kothe's #588 circuit with mutable sources and same-run hosting: the leftover helper pieces stored in idle data registers of the same run
statement: OpenAI's UniformFourier statement (DFT of every length and convolution), only the exponent and seven names changed

compared_with.what: Lean-checked record before these packages (Jeremy Kothe's #588 circuit in Ryan Shea's Lean tree, with 112 source copies)

also_compared_with.what: community/c588m (the same circuit with mutable sources, no hosting)

requires_note: laid over Shea's tree AFTER community/c588m (annealed variant): it reuses GXD.C588M (certificate, bank schedule, gauged invocation package) and Work/XMut; apply-overlay.sh applies c588m first

control.what: the hosted network with an EMPTY host table (every helper piece in a bank, as in community/c588m) must give exactly the figure of community/c588m

certificate.host_table: data/h588_c0_samerun.repacked2.json (same-run hosting: hosts from data/H588-hosttab.json, leftover pieces re-packed into 111 banks)

new_lean.Work/XHost: the hosted nine-stage network: role maps of a hosted stage (HRoles), the hosted invocation (HDef, HStage, HCert), host frames (Frames), host schedules (HSched) and the kernel checker hostSchedK with its soundness HostSched.ofTab_fitsR (HSchedK), the geometry of Shea's idle climbs (HGeom), the end theorem XHost.engine_of_ginv_host (HEnd), the empty host table (HBank), remainder prices (HPriceK), the instances C588MH (control) and C588MHH, and the data modules (Data/)
new_lean.Work/FourierC588MHH: the Fourier chain of the instance, made from community/c588m's chain with the seam pointed at XHost.engine_of_ginv_host
new_lean.supporting/: two lemmas proved as a plan before the network was built, compiled on the Mac and not imported by the modules above: L1 (supporting/L1, restating Shea's B401.gauged_step / gauged_Wn, GX.entW_spec / entW_form, GX.gauge_step) and L2 (supporting/L2, moving a helper's leftover piece into a host by a free relabelling of addresses; the result does this with host_adapt in Frames.lean, adapted from Mamano's bank_adapt)

checks.what: the 49 modules of the overlay compiled on the first Colab machine with plain lean over the built c588m tree, in rounds r2 to r14 while the agents fixed errors; the last compile of every module ended with exit 0, no sorry and no error (the earlier rounds' failures are in the same folder)
transform_mainC588MHH, convolution_mainC588MHH and the program hillsC588MHH_program depend on propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only; no sorryAx
